summary_1line: Krishna asks whom Jarasandha will fight; Jarasandha chooses Bhima, and the two begin a colossal bare‑handed wrestling duel before a vast crowd.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhima and Jarasandha lock their massive arms and slam foreheads together as sparks seem to fly, surrounded by a roaring crowd.
Jarasandha removes his crown, binds his hair, and strides forward like a bursting ocean to face Bhima in the arena.
The two warriors grapple like enraged elephants, lifting and hurling each other while thousands of spectators press together around the arena.
